limitations: Not a coding benchmark; no fictional implementation or checks were executed.
Evaluators were instructed not to read expected checks; isolation was instruction-scoped, not a security sandbox.
No per-task token/cost telemetry was available; do not infer cost or efficiency from this record.
These are historical results for the pinned source commit, not proof that future revisions pass.
protocol_corrections: Initial action field was unspecified free text while scorer expected enums; explicit neutral enum was then supplied and evaluator outputs regenerated without expected case answers.
Oracle accepted ownership_handoff as a valid immediate action when a fully approved implementation was ready.
Scorer gained global counter/reset and HOLD/PAUSE invariants after independent QA reproduced a false pass.
reproducibility: Original full tool/model transcripts are not bundled; the published artifacts are structured evaluator outputs and coordinator-recorded provenance, not a tamper-proof run log.
